query: SELECT a.title, a.description, a.age, a.decade, a.sageEnrichment, a.esf FROM achievements a WHERE a.clientId = 1149902 ORDER BY a.decade, a.age ASC LIMIT 20;
command: mysql --batch --raw --column-names --default-character-set=utf8mb4 --host gateway03.us-east-1.prod.aws.tidbcloud.com --port 4000 --user 32u3a1hNYuu9Gj3.7d2282893346 --database kFbbE6kqNApXGDFpQJUGV7 --execute SELECT a.title, a.description, a.age, a.decade, a.sageEnrichment, a.esf FROM achievements a WHERE a.clientId = 1149902 ORDER BY a.decade, a.age ASC LIMIT 20;

rows.title: [Mid (6-11)] lined up my dolls as if in a plane or in school
rows.description: organising them into a recognisable setting, being in charge
rows.sageEnrichment: Throughout her life she has enjoyed organizing information into logical sequences, both to understand it better herself and then to communicate the insights to others—a pattern she recognizes even in how she played with dolls as a child.

rows.title: [Mid (6-11)] Drawing and colouring
rows.description: Had to do it at school and really enjoyed it, but was more about eg choosing colours and staying within the lines or trying to reproduce another picture than doing anything original
rows.sageEnrichment: Covered in Sage session summary: Amanda demonstrates a consistent drive to identify structural problems and redesign them into logical, coherent solutions. Language and communication are central — she thinks out loud, values intellectual stimulation and the company of equals, and finds deep satisfaction in being understood. She is energised by independence and setting her own agenda, and finds fulfilment in seeing tangible real-world impact from her work.

rows.title: [Early (0-5)] Active - always running and moving and trying things out
rows.description: Full of energy and curiousity
rows.sageEnrichment: Covered in Sage session summary: Amanda demonstrates a consistent drive to identify structural problems and redesign them into logical, coherent solutions. Language and communication are central — she thinks out loud, values intellectual stimulation and the company of equals, and finds deep satisfaction in being understood. She is energised by independence and setting her own agenda, and finds fulfilment in seeing tangible real-world impact from her work.

rows.title: [Mid (6-11)] Learning french
rows.description: New school so to get involved I had to learn french fast, which I loved.  Still enjoy speaking languages
rows.sageEnrichment: She loved the physical act of using her mouth to form different words with different pronunciations, and found it deeply satisfying to be understood and to make progress in communication through the new language.

rows.title: [Mid (6-11)] Playing with our puppy
rows.description: Very affectionate, enjoyed the tactility of a soft cuddly puppy
rows.sageEnrichment: Covered in Sage session summary: Amanda demonstrates a consistent drive to identify structural problems and redesign them into logical, coherent solutions. Language and communication are central — she thinks out loud, values intellectual stimulation and the company of equals, and finds deep satisfaction in being understood. She is energised by independence and setting her own agenda, and finds fulfilment in seeing tangible real-world impact from her work.

rows.title: [Early (0-5)] Chatting
rows.description: Always chatting, to myself or my toys if necessary.  Always loved words.  Gregarious and outgoing, found it easy to make friends and play with other childrn
rows.sageEnrichment: She was thinking out loud while chatting, formulating her thoughts as she spoke—a practice she still finds helpful for organizing her own thinking and clarifying what is forming in her mind.

rows.title: [Early (0-5)] learning to swim, swimming and diving
rows.description: Loved the feeling of cool water on my skin and the freedom of moving in the water, competed in swimming galas
rows.sageEnrichment: She describes swimming as giving her a sensation of competence as well as freedom, where she could float, swim fast, practice diving in different ways, submerge, turn upside down, and enjoy using her muscles while feeling in control of her body and movement in the water.

rows.title: [Early (0-5)] playing with other children in new school in India
rows.description: exploring, loving the cultural differences of a new place, shy but loved learning and doing well
rows.sageEnrichment: Covered in Sage session summary: Amanda demonstrates a consistent drive to identify structural problems and redesign them into logical, coherent solutions. Language and communication are central — she thinks out loud, values intellectual stimulation and the company of equals, and finds deep satisfaction in being understood. She is energised by independence and setting her own agenda, and finds fulfilment in seeing tangible real-world impact from her work.

rows.description: Learnt to read early and fast, had lots of imaginary school friends
rows.sageEnrichment: Covered in Sage session summary: Amanda demonstrates a consistent drive to identify structural problems and redesign them into logical, coherent solutions. rows.title: [Mid (6-11)] playing ponies and circuses with schoolfriends
rows.description: Loved moving and gymnastics, handstands, cartwheels, always outdoors.  Again very outgoing with other children but preferred to be in charge
rows.sageEnrichment: Covered in Sage session summary: Amanda demonstrates a consistent drive to identify structural problems and redesign them into logical, coherent solutions. rows.title: [Late (12-18)] Sports
rows.description: Competing and using my limbs and my energy
rows.sageEnrichment: Covered in Sage session summary: Amanda demonstrates a consistent drive to identify structural problems and redesign them into logical, coherent solutions. She is energised by independence and setting her own agenda, and finds fulfilment in seeing tangible real-world impact from her work.

rows.title: [Late (12-18)] Reading and learning
rows.description: figuring out who I was and where I fitted into the hierarchy of society, absorbing academic and social knowledge
rows.sageEnrichment: Covered in Sage session summary: Amanda demonstrates a consistent drive to identify structural problems and redesign them into logical, coherent solutions. Language and communication are central — she thinks out loud, values intellectual stimulation and the company of equals, and finds deep satisfaction in being understood. She is energised by independence and setting her own agenda, and finds fulfilment in seeing tangible real-world impact from her work.

rows.title: [Late (12-18)] head girl
rows.description: liked being in charge, liked the responsibility, enjoyed the public speaking aspects
rows.sageEnrichment: What she found fulfilling was the ability to organize and improve things; while she had rules to follow, she was trusted to apply them in ways that made sense to her or to alter the rules if she could persuade teachers her changes were logical. Rather than seeking power, she valued the ability to change things rather than having to abide by illogical rules imposed by others.

rows.title: working
rows.description: learning about the world of work, and also adulthood
rows.sageEnrichment: Covered in Sage session summary: Amanda demonstrates a consistent drive to identify structural problems and redesign them into logical, coherent solutions. Language and communication are central — she thinks out loud, values intellectual stimulation and the company of equals, and finds deep satisfaction in being understood. She is energised by independence and setting her own agenda, and finds fulfilment in seeing tangible real-world impact from her work.

rows.title: Travelling and absorbing knowledge
rows.description: Travelling though south america, learning italian
rows.sageEnrichment: She had studied South American literature at school which was geographically grounded, did extensive research about where she wanted to visit, and was able to set her own agenda entirely independently, using her school Spanish to communicate and then applying it to learn Italian as a similar language.

rows.title: University
rows.description: understanding where I fitted into the social and academic hierarchy at university
rows.sageEnrichment: Unlike school with its strict timetables and supervised tasks, university's freedom required her to mindfully balance social life, work, sport, food, and sleep with a new group of high-achieving individuals. She found herself navigating ambiguity to figure out where the intellectual level was and where she fit in, along with everyone else thrown into the deep end. Once she found her intellectual equals who were also supportive and warm company, it became a time of interesting and stimulating conversations.

rows.title: studying
rows.description: working really hard at academic studies and really enjoying it, but not achieving top marks
rows.sageEnrichment: Covered in Sage session summary: Amanda demonstrates a consistent drive to identify structural problems and redesign them into logical, coherent solutions. Language and communication are central — she thinks out loud, values intellectual stimulation and the company of equals, and finds deep satisfaction in being understood. She is energised by independence and setting her own agenda, and finds fulfilment in seeing tangible real-world impact from her work.

rows.title: experimenting with different areas of work
rows.description: wanting to learn new skills and better use of existing skills that the bar didnt value
rows.sageEnrichment: She found the bar very academic, solo, not creative or sociable, and wanted to be more proactive. She experimented by trying to fashion solutions to problems she encountered in her own life that weren't being solved: Apartfrom helped young professionals make better use of their limited leisure time, while funditfrog helped new parents find what they needed whilst also donating to charity.

rows.title: Entrepreneurship
rows.description: starting to want more freedom and a broader interaction with the world of work
rows.sageEnrichment: Covered in Sage session summary: Amanda demonstrates a consistent drive to identify structural problems and redesign them into logical, coherent solutions. Language and communication are central — she thinks out loud, values intellectual stimulation and the company of equals, and finds deep satisfaction in being understood. She is energised by independence and setting her own agenda, and finds fulfilment in seeing tangible real-world impact from her work.
